title: When a Correct Reward Is Not Enough: Diagnosing and Guiding PPO in an Analytically Solved Broker-Trader Game
title_zh: 当正确奖励不足时：在解析求解的经纪商-交易者游戏中诊断与引导PPO

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used for financial optimal-control problems when complex dynamics make analytical strategies difficult to obtain. There are financial mathematics literactures which provides many solved models whose equations and controls could evaluate and guide learning; we ask whether RL can exploit these results.
paragraphs.zh: 当复杂动态使得解析策略难以获得时，强化学习（RL）正越来越多地应用于金融最优控制问题。 金融数学文献中提供了许多已求解的模型，其方程和控制方案可用于评估和指导学习；我们想知道强化学习能否利用这些成果。

sents.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used for financial optimal-control problems when complex dynamics make analytical strategies difficult to obtain.
sents.zh: 当复杂动态使得解析策略难以获得时，强化学习（RL）正越来越多地应用于金融最优控制问题。

sents.en: There are financial mathematics literactures which provides many solved models whose equations and controls could evaluate and guide learning; we ask whether RL can exploit these results.
sents.zh: 金融数学文献中提供了许多已求解的模型，其方程和控制方案可用于评估和指导学习；我们想知道强化学习能否利用这些成果。

paragraphs.en: We place a proximal policy optimisation (PPO) agent in an analytically solved continuous-time broker–trader game. PPO replaces the broker and chooses its trading speed while interacting with an informed trader and stochastic uninformed order flow. We derive a finite-step reward from the broker’s continuous-time payoff and verify its discrete implementation through grid refinement and an exact one-step identity. With zero uninformed flow, a validation-selected PPO–FFNN approaches the reference action. With stochastic uninformed flow, the tested PPO–FFNN and PPO–LSTM remain inaccurate, although supervised learning confirms that their actors can represent the action. Monte Carlo diagnostics show that their critics do not reliably rank nearby actions; potential-based reward shaping also gives no reliable improvement. Under partial information, a causal certainty-equivalent controller based on the broker’s observable history remains close to the reference, while PPO has larger errors and lower payoffs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将一个近端策略优化（PPO）智能体置于一个通过解析法求解的连续时间经纪商–交易员博弈中。 PPO 取代了经纪商，在与知情交易员和随机非知情订单流互动时选择其交易速度。 我们从经纪商的连续时间收益中推导出有限步奖励，并通过网格细化与精确的一步恒等式验证其离散实现。 在没有非知情订单流的情况下，经验证选择的 PPO–FFNN 能够接近参考动作。 在存在随机非知情订单流时，经过测试的 PPO–FFNN 和 PPO–LSTM 仍然不够准确，尽管监督学习证实了它们的执行器能够表示该动作。 蒙特卡洛诊断表明，它们的批评器无法可靠地对邻近动作进行排序；基于势能的奖励塑造也未带来可靠的改进。 在部分信息条件下，基于经纪商可观测历史的因果确定性等效控制器仍接近参考值，而 PPO 的误差更大且收益更低。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we freeze the analytical policy and train PPO to adjust it after the execution cost changes. Halving the cost yields a repeatable improvement that closes 2.22 % 2.22\% of the gap to the changed-cost reference. The analytical solution therefore provides both a benchmark for diagnosing RL and a useful starting policy for adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们冻结分析策略，并训练 PPO 在执行成本变化后对其进行调整。 将成本减半可带来可重复的改进，从而缩小了 2.22 % 2.22\% 与成本变化参考值之间的差距。 因此，该分析解既为诊断强化学习提供了基准，也为策略适应提供了一个有用的初始策略。

paragraphs.en: Optimal execution balances execution costs against inventory exposure and adverse price movements. Reinforcement learning (RL) is attractive when richer market dynamics make analytical strategies difficult to obtain. We ask whether RL can recover an analytically known broker strategy from its performance criterion and use that strategy after the environment changes.
paragraphs.zh: 最优执行需要在执行成本、库存敞口以及不利价格波动之间取得平衡。 当更复杂的市场动态使得解析策略难以获得时，强化学习（RL）便显得颇具吸引力。 我们想知道，强化学习能否根据其绩效标准恢复出已知解析解的经纪策略，并在环境变化后应用该策略。

paragraphs.en: Our environment follows the continuous-time game of Cartea, Jaimungal, and Sánchez-Betancourt ( Cartea et al., 2026 ) , who model the interaction between a broker, an informed trader, and an uninformed trader. The broker internalises client orders and hedges in the lit market. Informed flow contains private information, while rapid trading is costly and slow trading leaves inventory exposed. Their analytical equilibrium gives an action at every state, allowing same-state action comparisons together with realised payoffs and inventory trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的环境遵循 Cartea、Jaimungal 和 Sánchez-Betancourt（Cartea 等人，2026）提出的连续时间博弈模型，该模型描述了经纪商、知情交易者和非知情交易者之间的互动。 经纪商会将客户订单内化，并在公开市场上进行对冲。 信息流包含私有信息，而快速交易成本高昂，缓慢交易则会使持仓暴露于风险之中。 他们的分析均衡为每个状态提供了具体行动，从而能够比较同一状态下的不同行动，并结合实际收益与持仓轨迹进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Prior studies use RL to adjust an Almgren–Chriss schedule, learn liquidation policies against analytical benchmarks, or structure actor–critic learning with closed-form policy and value functions ( Hendricks and Wilcox, 2014 ; Macrì and Lillo, 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . They do not test whether a finite-step reward recovers the known state-dependent strategy in this broker–trader game. Analytical-policy initialisation and adaptation have also been proposed ( Ning et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . We separate discretisation, policy learning, and hidden-state estimation.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究利用强化学习来调整 Almgren–Chriss 交易计划，针对分析基准学习清算策略，或者构建结合闭式策略与价值函数的演员–评论家学习框架（Hendricks 和 Wilcox, 2014；Macrì 和 Lillo, 2024；Wang 等, 2026）。 这些研究并未检验有限步奖励能否在此经纪商–交易员博弈中恢复已知的状态依赖策略。 基于分析策略的初始化和自适应方法也已被提出（Ning 等, 2021；Wang 等, 2026）。 我们将离散化、策略学习和隐藏状态估计三个环节分离处理。

paragraphs.en: RQ1: Full-information control. Can PPO–FFNN and PPO–LSTM recover the broker’s analytical trading strategy when every relevant state variable is observed?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题 1：完全信息控制。 当所有相关状态变量均可观测时，PPO–FFNN 和 PPO–LSTM 能否恢复经纪商的分析交易策略？

sents.en: RQ1: Full-information control.
sents.zh: 研究问题 1：完全信息控制。

sents.en: Can PPO–FFNN and PPO–LSTM recover the broker’s analytical trading strategy when every relevant state variable is observed?
sents.zh: 当所有相关状态变量均可观测时，PPO–FFNN 和 PPO–LSTM 能否恢复经纪商的分析交易策略？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: Partial-information control. How closely can PPO–FFNN and PPO–LSTM approach the certainty-equivalent benchmark ( Mania et al., 2019 ) when the informed trader’s inventory, signal, and current trading rate are hidden?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：部分信息控制。 当知情交易者的持仓、信号和当前交易速率被隐藏时，PPO–FFNN 和 PPO–LSTM 能有多接近确定性等效基准（Mania et al., 2019）？

paragraphs.en: RQ3: Adapting an analytical policy. When the execution cost differs from the value used to calculate the analytical policy, can PPO learn an adjustment that improves the unchanged policy?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题 3：调整分析策略。 当执行成本与用于计算分析策略的数值不同时，PPO 能否学会一种调整方法，从而改进未变更的策略？

paragraphs.en: Section 2 reviews related work, Section 3 introduces the environment, Section 4 answers RQ1–RQ2, and Section 5 answers RQ3.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节回顾了相关研究，第 3 节介绍了环境，第 4 节回答了 RQ1–RQ2，而第 5 节则回答了 RQ3。

paragraphs.en: Analytical execution models relate trading actions to inventory, impact, order flow, and predictive signals ( Cartea and Jaimungal, 2016 ; Casgrain and Jaimungal, 2019 ) . Broker–trader games add strategic interaction because hedging affects prices while client orders change the broker’s inventory and information ( Cartea et al., 2026 ; Wu and Jaimungal, 2024 ) . We use the known broker action as the RL target.
paragraphs.zh: 分析执行模型将交易行为与库存、影响、订单流和预测信号相关联（Cartea 和 Jaimungal，2016；Casgrain 和 Jaimungal，2019）。 经纪商-交易者博弈引入了战略互动，因为对冲会影响价格，而客户订单则会改变经纪商的库存和信息（Cartea 等，2026；Wu 和 Jaimungal，2024）。 我们将已知的经纪商行为用作强化学习的目标。

paragraphs.en: RL has learned liquidation schedules through value-based methods, PPO, and continuous-time actor–critic ( Nevmyvaka et al., 2006 ; Lin and Beling, 2020 ; Ning et al., 2021 ; Moallemi and Wang, 2022 ; Koulouris and Campajola, 2026 ) . Hybrid methods adjust or initialise from an analytical schedule, or embed closed-form structure ( Hendricks and Wilcox, 2014 ; Ning et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . The broker–trader equilibrium instead permits same-state action comparisons. Although policy gradients have convergence results for linear–quadratic control ( Fazel et al., 2018 ) , PPO remains sensitive to implementation and evaluation choices ( Engstrom et al., 2020 ; Andrychowicz et al., 2020 ; Henderson et al., 2018 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习已通过基于价值的方法、PPO 和连续时间演员-评论家方法学会了清算时间表（Nevmyvaka 等人，2006；Lin 和 Beling，2020；Ning 等人，2021；Moallemi 和 Wang，2022；Koulouris 和 Campajola，2026）。 混合方法通过调整或从解析时间表初始化，或者嵌入闭式结构（Hendricks 和 Wilcox，2014；Ning 等人，2021；Wang 等人，2026）。 相反，经纪商-交易员均衡允许对相同状态下的动作进行比较。 尽管策略梯度在线性-二次控制问题中具有收敛性结果（Fazel 等人，2018），但 PPO 仍然对实现和评估的选择较为敏感（Engstrom 等人，2020；Andrychowicz 等人，2020；Henderson 等人，2018）。

paragraphs.en: Analytical equations can guide learning and provide a benchmark. Prior work adds a Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman loss or closed-form policy and value structure ( Mukherjee and Liu, 2023 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Residual RL adds a learned action to an existing controller ( Johannink et al., 2019 ) ; in Section 5, we use it to adjust the frozen broker action after the execution cost changes. We also test potential-based shaping, which preserves policy ordering ( Ng et al., 1999 ; Sowerby et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 分析方程可以指导学习并提供基准。 先前的研究加入了哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼损失函数或闭式策略与价值结构（Mukherjee 和 Liu，2023；Wang 等，2026）。 残差强化学习在现有控制器中加入一个学习到的动作（Johannink 等，2019）；在第 5 节中，我们用它来在执行成本变化后调整已冻结的经纪商动作。 我们还测试了基于势能的塑造方法，该方法能够保持策略的顺序性（Ng 等，1999；Sowerby 等，2022）。

paragraphs.en: With hidden state, an agent can summarise observations recurrently or estimate the hidden variables explicitly ( Igl et al., 2018 ; Lambrechts et al., 2022 ) . paragraphs.en: We studied whether PPO can recover and subsequently adapt an analytically known broker strategy. For RQ1, we have shown that PPO–FFNN approaches ν k ref \nu_{k}^{\mathrm{ref}} under full information when ξ = 0 \xi=0 , however when ξ = 100 \xi=100 , the policies remain inaccurate. The finite-step reward and grid-refinement results show that these errors are not caused by numerical issues, while supervised learning shows that the FFNN can approximate and execute the reference action on states generated by the analytical policy. The critic diagnostic shows inaccurate local action ranking can contribute to the difficulty of learning from rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了 PPO 是否能够恢复并随后适应一种通过解析方法已知的经纪策略。 对于研究问题 1，我们已经证明，在 ξ = 0 的情况下，PPO–FFNN 在完全信息条件下能够逼近 ν k ref \nu_{k}^{\mathrm{ref}}；然而，当 ξ = 100 时，这些策略仍然不准确。 有限步奖励和网格细化结果表明，这些错误并非由数值问题引起；而监督学习则表明，FFNN 能够近似并执行由解析策略生成的状态下的参考动作。 评论器诊断显示，不准确的局部动作排序可能会增加从奖励中学习时的难度。

Its performance shows that the available history supports accurate control in this environment, while PPO–FFNN and PPO–LSTM do not learn to use that information as effectively.

paragraphs.en: For RQ3, the frozen analytical policy provides an accurate starting strategy after the execution cost changes. Residual PPO produces a small and repeatable payoff improvement when the cost is halved. The analytical solution is therefore useful both as a benchmark for diagnosing learned policies and as a prior for subsequent adaptation, thus providing some evidence of analytical policy initialisation being useful ( Ning et al., 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 对于研究问题3，在执行成本发生变化后，冻结的分析策略能够提供一个准确的初始策略。 当成本减半时，残差PPO能带来微小且可重复的收益提升。 因此，该解析解既可用于作为诊断已学习策略的基准，也可用作后续适应的先验知识，从而为分析策略初始化具有实用性提供了一定证据（Ning等，2021）。

paragraphs.en: The numerical checks and supervised learning make discretisation, reward implementation, and insufficient FFNN capacity unlikely to be the primary limitations. A more plausible explanation is the interaction between exploration and reward-based value estimation. Wider initial exploration improves PPO when ξ = 0 \xi=0 , but performance remains poor after stochastic uninformed flow is introduced, where the critic also shows weak local action ranking. Partial information additionally requires relevant information to be recovered from past observations. When an analytical policy is already available, wider exploration can instead move the adjustment away from a useful starting point, while conservative adjustments produce a small improvement under the lower-cost misspecification.
paragraphs.zh: 数值检验和监督学习使得离散化、奖励实现以及前馈神经网络（FFNN）容量不足不太可能成为主要限制因素。 更合理的解释是探索与基于奖励的价值估计之间的相互作用。 当 ξ = 0 \xi=0 时，更广泛的初始探索能提升 PPO 的性能，但在引入随机无信息流后，性能仍然不佳，此时批评者对局部动作的排序能力也较弱。 此外，部分信息还要求从过去的观察中恢复相关信息。 当已有解析策略时，更广泛的探索反而可能使调整偏离一个有效的起点，而保守的调整在低成本误设的情况下仅能带来微小改进。

paragraphs.en: Future work can use analytical value or action-value information to improve the local learning signal, study alternative action and policy parameterisations, and develop structured residual policies for nonlinear costs or uncertain market impact. Under partial information, it would be interesting to test the performance of the model by introducing a filter into the actor, and practical applications for the partial information setting would include having a ξ + η \xi+\eta flow.
